tenderSchedule.title: Providing food and other supplies to 03 elephants participating in the Shivamogga Dasara 2026 festival procession.
tenderSchedule.description: Providing food and other supplies to 03 elephants participating in the Shivamogga Dasara 2026 festival procession.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
For detailed specification refer to attached detailed estimation.
The rates quoted by the tenderer should be inclusive of all taxes
All terms and conditions as per tender document

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: All other documents as per tender document
Details of bidder having own/hired 4 wheel transporting vehicle
Legal Metrology Packing Department licence-LMPC Certificate
One Year Experience Certificate of Supply of Food Materials to Dasara Elephants in any state level dasara event in last five years
Tenderer must have Registered / Renewed his Name as Forest Contractor in Forest Department in Karnataka State before E-Tender Notification date
The annual turnover of the tenderer should be Rs.5.50 Lakhs Charted Accountant officer certified in any one year in last five financial years document should be submitted
The Contractor should execute an affidavit on Rs. 100 stamp paper stating that he is not black listed.
Upload the certificate and Food safety standards FSSAI act 2006 certificate Authority of India act 2006
